In this video, I’m opening up about some hard-earned truths and the life-changing lessons I’ve learned over the past couple of years. Growing up, I was taught that “what you put in is what you get out,” but reality has shown me a more complex picture—one where superlinear returns, luck, and intent play a huge role in shaping success.
I’ll be sharing three pivotal stories:
The struggle and eventual success of starting Aevy.
How understanding and leveraging superlinear returns have been key to our growth.
